assets.originalPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production raster paper-doll sprite atlas for a 2D Kuwaiti family dance game.
Primary request: Create one clean 2560 by 2048 PNG image with a strict invisible grid of FOUR ROWS by FIVE COLUMNS, 20 isolated fully drawn parts total. Each row is one character decomposed into separate animation pieces, NOT five full character poses. All cells equal 512x512; each part centered in its own cell, with ample blank margin. No grid lines or text.
Input image is STYLE AND CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE only. Preserve its warm playful hand-painted arcade sprite look, bold dark crisp contours, lively large eyes, pleasing shaded colors and friendly expressions. Front view with very slight dimensional shading, clean production assets.
Column 1: one unified HEAD + NECK + TORSO + MAIN CLOTHING body. Completely remove both arms and both feet from this body, close/paint the shoulder joint ends. For dishdasha, abaya, or dress, the complete long skirt is integral to this body.
Column 2: detached VIEWER-LEFT arm with sleeve and hand, extending STRAIGHT DOWN vertically from a ROUND painted shoulder end to fingertips. Neutral relaxed open hand, no bent elbow, no raised arm.
Column 3: detached VIEWER-RIGHT arm with sleeve and hand, extending STRAIGHT DOWN vertically from round painted shoulder end to fingertips. It matches column 2 as the opposite side. No bent elbow.
Column 4: detached VIEWER-LEFT leg ending in shoe or paw, perfectly straight down, with ROUND fully colored top joint.
Column 5: detached VIEWER-RIGHT leg ending in shoe or paw, perfectly straight down, with ROUND fully colored top joint.
All five parts IN EACH ROW are DRAWN AT THE SAME SCALE relative to each other, so they can be recombined into one naturally proportioned character. The head/body is about 420px tall. Human arms are about 190px long from shoulder to hand. For long robes/dresses, separate feet include about 70px of lower leg plus shoes so the upper end can overlap under the skirt. Animals/robots have about 180px straight legs. Arms and legs must NOT be enlarged just to fill their cells.
Technical constraints: truly transparent empty background with clean alpha, no checkerboard picture, no ground shadows. If alpha is impossible, use perfectly flat saturated #00ff00 green. Each of the 20 parts must have at least 32px clear margin around it and never touch another cell. Distal limbs completely detached from body; no duplicate arms, feet, hands, legs, labels, decorations, props, pedestal, floor, watermark. Draw complete rounded joint endings in matching material colors so animation rotation overlaps smoothly. Main bodies face directly forward, upright neutral stance; no leaning, dance poses, raised knees, or bent arms.
ROW 1: Friendly smiling adult Kuwaiti man with thick black mustache, white ghutra with black agal, white dishdasha. Tan skin. White sleeves, tan hands, brown leather sandals.
ROW 2: Friendly woman in rich turquoise modest long dress and matching turquoise hijab, subtle traditional gold embroidery on chest, cuffs and hem. Turquoise sleeves and shoes, tan hands.
ROW 3: Happy Kuwaiti boy with clearly visible SHORT BLACK HAIR and NO HEADWEAR: absolutely NO CAP, NO HAT, no taqiyah, no ghutra. His hair is rounded short black hair with a small natural fringe. White dishdasha, white sleeves, tan hands, black sneakers with white soles.
ROW 4: Happy girl in purple long dress and purple hijab, understated gold embroidery on chest, cuffs, hem. Purple sleeves, tan hands, white-and-purple sneakers.
Critical: the boy MUST have uncovered short black hair. Each row is body, left arm, right arm, left leg/shoe, right leg/shoe; exactly twenty disconnected parts.
